nodes.title: Round Started
nodes.help: Runs when a round begins: freeze time is over and everyone can move.

nodes.title: Round Ended
nodes.help: Runs when a round ends. Winner is no team for a draw.

nodes.title: Player Killed
nodes.help: Runs when a player dies. Attacker is nobody when the world killed them (a fall, the bomb).

nodes.title: Player Spawned
nodes.help: Runs when a player comes alive (each round, or a respawn).

nodes.title: Player Joined
nodes.help: Runs when a player (or bot) has joined the server.

nodes.title: Player Left
nodes.help: Runs when a player leaves the server.

nodes.title: Bomb Planted
nodes.help: Runs when the bomb is planted.

nodes.title: Bomb Defused
nodes.help: Runs when the bomb is defused.

nodes.title: Bomb Exploded
nodes.help: Runs when the bomb goes off.

nodes.title: Player Used
nodes.help: Runs when a player presses a button (func_button) with this name. Leave the name empty for any button.

nodes.title: Player Touched
nodes.help: Runs when a player walks into a trigger (trigger_multiple) with this name, at most once a second each. Empty name: any.

nodes.title: Point Captured
nodes.help: A capture point was taken.

nodes.title: Point Lost
nodes.help: A team lost a capture point.

nodes.title: Zone Stage
nodes.help: A shrinking zone started a new stage.

nodes.title: Zone Hurt Player
nodes.help: A player outside the zone took damage.

nodes.title: Player Extracted
nodes.help: A player got out at an extraction point.

nodes.title: Wave Started
nodes.help: A wave of enemies started.

nodes.title: Wave Spawned One
nodes.help: A wave's spawner is about to bring in one enemy. Spawner is the wave spawner, not the enemy (it isn't made yet): to act on its enemies, use For Each Creature (a moment later) or Creature Killed.

nodes.title: Wave Cleared
nodes.help: Every enemy of a wave is dead.

nodes.title: Crate Opened
nodes.help: A player opened a loot container.

nodes.title: Checkpoint Reached
nodes.help: A player reached a checkpoint.

nodes.title: Barricade Damaged
nodes.help: A barricade was hit (Health is what it has left).

nodes.title: Barricade Repaired
nodes.help: A barricade was mended a step (by Player; nobody when the mode did it).

nodes.title: Supply Drop Landed
nodes.help: A supply drop came down (it can be opened now).

nodes.title: Barricade Broken
nodes.help: A barricade was broken.

nodes.title: Meeting Ended
nodes.help: A meeting ended; Ejected is nobody when no one was voted out.

nodes.title: Creature Killed
nodes.help: A creature died. Needs the Loner-Strike bot brain with creatures.

nodes.title: Is Team
nodes.help: Checks which team a player is on. Nobody (an empty attacker) is on no team, so that goes to False.

nodes.title: Branch
nodes.help: Goes to True or False.

nodes.title: Compare
nodes.help: Compares two numbers.
nodes.keywords: > >= < <= == != = greater less more than equal compare bigger smaller

nodes.title: And / Or
nodes.help: Both (And), or either one (Or).

nodes.title: Not
nodes.help: True becomes False and False becomes True.

nodes.title: Math
nodes.help: Adds, takes away, multiplies, divides, or picks the smaller or bigger number.
nodes.keywords: mod modulo % remainder plus minus times divide power

nodes.title: Random Number
nodes.help: A random number from Min to Max (whole numbers unless Fractions is on).

nodes.title: Health Of
nodes.help: A player's health (0 if dead or nobody).

nodes.title: Team Of
nodes.help: Which team a player is on.

nodes.title: Is Alive
nodes.help: Is the player alive?

nodes.title: Is Bot
nodes.help: Is the player a bot?

nodes.title: Name Of
nodes.help: A player's name, as text.

nodes.title: Count Alive
nodes.help: How many players of a team are alive (or everyone).

nodes.title: Get Variable
nodes.help: Reads one of this mode's variables (a per-player one needs a Player, a per-team one a Team).

nodes.title: Set Variable
nodes.help: Sets one of this mode's variables.

nodes.title: Add To Variable
nodes.help: Adds to a number variable (a negative amount takes away).

nodes.title: Delay
nodes.help: Waits, then carries on. Paused with the world while debugging.

nodes.title: Repeat
nodes.help: Runs Each every few seconds, a number of times (0: until the round ends). Then runs at once.

nodes.title: Countdown
nodes.help: Counts down on everyone's screen, then runs Done.

nodes.title: Stop Timers
nodes.help: Stops every Delay, Repeat and Countdown of this mode.

nodes.title: Give Weapon
nodes.help: Gives a living player a weapon and spare bullets. Does nothing for a dead player, or one who already has that weapon (the debugger marks that). A weapon's name can be wired in (from a data table, say): ak47, deagle, knife...

nodes.title: Strip Weapons
nodes.help: Takes a player's weapons away (keeping the knife if you like).

nodes.title: Set Health
nodes.help: Sets a living player's health.

nodes.title: Set Armor
nodes.help: Sets a living player's armor (with a helmet).

nodes.title: Set Team
nodes.help: Moves a player to a team (it shows from their next spawn).

nodes.title: Set Speed
nodes.help: Sets how fast a player runs (250 is normal) until they switch weapons.

nodes.title: Teleport
nodes.help: Moves a living player to an entity: the one wired into To, or the one with this name.

nodes.title: Show Message
nodes.help: Shows a big message in the middle of the screen, to one player or everyone (no Player).

nodes.title: Show HUD Text
nodes.help: Shows text in a HUD slot, to one player or everyone (no Player). A Value wired in goes after the text.

nodes.title: End Round
nodes.help: Ends the round now with a winner (no team: a draw). The next round starts after the usual short wait.

nodes.title: Find Component
nodes.help: The component (or any entity) with this name.

nodes.title: Create Component
nodes.help: Makes a component at an entity (wired into At, or the one with this name), with keys like radius=160 capture_secs=8.

nodes.title: Set Zone
nodes.help: Sets a safe zone's radius (wire the Safe zone, or the Shrinking zone that drives it), and moves its center to an entity wired into Center or the one with this name (no name: it stays where it is).

nodes.title: Shrink Zone
nodes.help: Shrinks a safe zone (or a Shrinking zone's) over some seconds to a new radius, around an entity wired into Center or the one with this name (no name: its center stays).

params.label: New center at the entity named

nodes.title: Open Crate
nodes.help: Opens a loot container for a player.

nodes.title: Start Wave
nodes.help: Starts a wave (0: the next one).

nodes.title: Stop Waves
nodes.help: Stops the waves.

nodes.title: Open Extraction
nodes.help: Opens or closes an extraction point.

nodes.title: Door
nodes.help: Opens or closes a timed door.

nodes.title: Set Barricade Health
nodes.help: Sets a barricade's health (0 breaks it; above 0 stands it back up).

nodes.title: Repair Barricade
nodes.help: Mends a barricade fully, or one step as if the wired Player held USE on it.

nodes.title: Roll Loot
nodes.help: Rolls one item from a loot table (configs/gamemodes/loot.ini), only items of this tier or lower (0: any).

nodes.title: Next Zone Stage Now
nodes.help: A Shrinking zone goes to its next stage now.

nodes.title: Fire Trap
nodes.help: Sets off a trap.

nodes.title: Lock Point
nodes.help: Locks a capture point for some seconds.

nodes.title: Reset Components
nodes.help: Puts every component back as it was at the start of the map.

nodes.title: Creature Health
nodes.help: A creature's health now (0 when it's gone).

nodes.title: Spawn Creature
nodes.help: Makes a creature of this type at an entity (wired into At, or the one with this name). Needs the Loner-Strike bot brain with creatures (the debugger says so if not).

nodes.title: Player Hurt
nodes.help: Runs when a player takes damage, with the health it took (blocked damage doesn't count). Hit Position: where a bullet or the knife struck (else the middle of the victim); Direction: which way the hit was going (from the attacker). Use Get Transform on Victim/Attacker for where they were.

nodes.title: Team Changed
nodes.help: Runs once when a player joins a team or changes team (Spectator is No team).

nodes.title: Map Started
nodes.help: Runs once when the map has loaded (before the first round): load map packs, set things up.

nodes.title: New Round
nodes.help: Runs when a new round is set up (freeze time starts), before Round Started.

nodes.title: Chat Command
nodes.help: Runs when a player says /command or !command in chat (shop for /shop and !shop); Arguments is the rest of the line ("/give 5": 5).

nodes.title: Function
nodes.help: A piece of graph you can run from anywhere with Call Function. It gets a Player and a Number from the call.

nodes.title: Call Function
nodes.help: Runs a Function, giving it a Player and a Number, then carries on.

nodes.title: For Each Player
nodes.help: Runs Each once for every player who fits, then Then.

nodes.title: For Each Entity
nodes.help: Runs Each once for every entity of a kind or with a name (at most 512), then Then.

nodes.title: Pick Random Player
nodes.help: Picks one player who fits at random (Found), or runs None.

nodes.title: Pick Random Entity
nodes.help: Picks one entity of a kind or with a name at random (Found), or runs None.

nodes.title: Text Is
nodes.help: Is the text the same as this (capitals don't matter)?

nodes.title: Stop Timer
nodes.help: Stops one Delay, Repeat or Countdown.

nodes.title: Give Money
nodes.help: Gives (or takes, with a minus) money; it stays between 0 and 16000.

nodes.title: Money Of
nodes.help: How much money a player has.

nodes.title: Add Score
nodes.help: Adds to a player's score (frags) on the scoreboard (a minus takes away).

nodes.title: Score Of
nodes.help: A player's score (frags).

nodes.title: Deaths Of
nodes.help: How many times a player has died.

nodes.title: Give Item
nodes.help: Gives a living player armor, a defuse kit or night vision.

nodes.title: Drop Weapon
nodes.help: Makes a living player drop the weapon in their hands.

nodes.title: Set Gravity
nodes.help: How strongly a player falls (1 is normal, 0.5 half).

nodes.title: Set Glow
nodes.help: Makes a player glow in a color (or not).

nodes.title: Set Model
nodes.help: Dresses a player as one of the game's characters (or back to their own).

nodes.title: Respawn
nodes.help: Brings a dead player back at a spawn point.

nodes.title: Kill
nodes.help: Kills a living player.

nodes.title: Freeze
nodes.help: Freezes a player in place (or lets them move again).

nodes.title: Set Role
nodes.help: Gives a player a role in this mode (traitor, medic...).

nodes.title: Is Role
nodes.help: Does the player have this role?

nodes.title: Count Role
nodes.help: How many living players have this role.

nodes.title: Chat Message
nodes.help: A chat line, to one player or everyone (no Player). A Value wired in goes after the text.

nodes.title: Progress Bar
nodes.help: Shows the game's progress bar filling up over some seconds.

nodes.title: Menu
nodes.help: Shows a player a menu; the choice they pick runs its output (later, when they pick).

nodes.title: Play Sound
nodes.help: Plays one of the game's sounds to one player or everyone.

nodes.title: Set Setting
nodes.help: Changes one of the game's settings now.

params.label: Setting
choices: Rounds only end when the mode says (1 on)
Most players more than the other team (0 any)
Downed players can be finished by enemies (1 on; components)
A downed player's health when they can be finished (components)

nodes.title: Use Entity
nodes.help: Presses (uses) every entity with this name: a door, a button, a trigger.

nodes.title: Set Player Modifier
nodes.help: Multiplies something about a player until they die: max health, speed, reload or swap time (0.6 = 40 % faster), damage, revive time, fire rate (1.25 = 25 % faster). Perks multiply on top.

nodes.title: Player Modifier
nodes.help: What a player's modifier is now (the mode's times the perks').

nodes.title: Give Perk
nodes.help: Gives a player a perk (lost when downed or dead).

nodes.title: Buy Perk
nodes.help: A player buys a perk for its price (1500 + 1000 per perk they have, 4 at most); Bought says if it worked.

nodes.title: Has Perk
nodes.help: Does the player have this perk?

nodes.title: Perk Count
nodes.help: How many perks a player has.

nodes.title: Weapon Level
nodes.help: The level of the gun in the player's hand (1, 2 Mk II, 3 Mk III).

nodes.title: Upgrade Gun
nodes.help: Upgrades the gun in the player's hand at the bench's prices (or 5000 / 9000).

nodes.title: Roll Mystery Box
nodes.help: The player rolls the mystery box (the one that's out, or the wired one) for its price.

nodes.title: Drop Pickup
nodes.help: Drops a pickup at an entity; whoever walks over it takes it (Pickup Taken says what it was). A kind like resupply, doublepay, onehit, airstrike, or anything you handle yourself.

nodes.title: Perk Bought
nodes.help: A player bought a perk (at a machine, a shop or Buy Perk).

nodes.title: Gun Upgraded
nodes.help: A player's gun went up a level.

nodes.title: Mystery Box Gave
nodes.help: The mystery box gave a player a gun.

nodes.title: Pickup Taken
nodes.help: A player took a pickup.

nodes.title: Creature Hurt
nodes.help: A creature took damage (Headshot when the hit was a head). Hit Position: where a bullet or the knife struck (else its middle); Direction: which way the hit was going. Use Get Entity Transform on Creature, or Get Transform on Attacker, for where they were.

nodes.title: Knocked Down On
nodes.help: On: a hit that would kill a player (of a team, or anyone) knocks them down instead: they crawl and bleed out over some seconds; a teammate (a squad mate, with squads) holding USE for 4 s gets them up with 50 health. Off: nobody new goes down.

nodes.title: Is Knocked Down
nodes.help: Is the player knocked down?

nodes.title: Bleed Out In
nodes.help: Seconds a knocked-down player has left (0 when they're not down).

nodes.title: Knock Down
nodes.help: Knocks a player down now.

nodes.title: Get Up
nodes.help: Gets a knocked-down player up (by the wired player, or nobody).

nodes.title: Knocked Down
nodes.help: A player was knocked down.

nodes.title: Got Up
nodes.help: A knocked-down player is back up (By: who helped; themselves for Quick revive; nobody when the mode did it).

nodes.title: Bled Out
nodes.help: A knocked-down player bled out (they die right after).

nodes.title: Open Shop Menu
nodes.help: Shows a player the shop's menu.

nodes.title: Open or Close Shop
nodes.help: Opens the shop for business, or closes it.

nodes.title: Shop Price
nodes.help: An item's price now (by its name or what it gives); -1 if the shop doesn't sell it.

nodes.title: Shop Purchase
nodes.help: A player bought something at a shop (an @item is the mode's to give here).

nodes.title: Talked To NPC
nodes.help: Runs when a player presses USE on an NPC (after its greeting). Leave the name empty for any NPC.
nodes.keywords: talk speak conversation dialogue npc character quest

nodes.title: Used Interactable
nodes.help: Runs when a player uses an interactable (a lever, a note, a terminal); its map targets fire too. Leave the name empty for any.
nodes.keywords: use press lever note terminal pickup interact

nodes.title: Say and Choose
nodes.help: The NPC (or a narrator, with none wired) says a line and the player picks a reply; each reply runs its output (later, when they pick), and Picked says which (1-6; 0 for none). Timed out: no pick in time. Walked away: they went off, died, left or closed it. Every text can be wired (a variable, a table cell), so one node can run a whole conversation from a data table; Replies sets how many are offered (empty ones are left out). One conversation per player: a new one ends the old (as Walked away).
nodes.keywords: dialogue talk conversation reply answer menu quest table

nodes.title: Say
nodes.help: The NPC (or a narrator, with none wired) says a line to a player, or to everyone with no Player.

nodes.title: Set NPC Behavior
nodes.help: What an NPC does by itself: stands, wanders near its spot, patrols its targets, or follows a player (wired into Follow) for a while.
nodes.keywords: ai wander patrol follow stand idle

nodes.title: NPC Look At
nodes.help: Turns an NPC to face a player or an entity.

nodes.title: Spawn NPC
nodes.help: Makes an NPC at an entity (wired into At), a point, or the entity with this name. Its model is loaded with the map (models/...mdl).
nodes.keywords: npc character create make quest giver

nodes.title: Spawn Interactable
nodes.help: Makes an interactable at an entity (wired into At), a point, or the entity with this name: a model players use (E), with a prompt when they look at it. Once: usable once a round.
nodes.keywords: interactable lever note terminal pickup usable create

nodes.title: Spawn Projectile
nodes.help: Fires a model or sprite (loaded with the map). Where from: Position, else At entity (a player's eyes) moved by the offsets along its facing, else the owner's eyes. Which way: Direction, else Rotation, else the way At entity (or the owner) faces, turned by Rotation offset; Velocity, when wired, sets the motion outright. Gravity 0 flies straight; 1 falls like a grenade. Bounces: off walls before it stops. Damage: to what it hits, or everything within Radius (less further out with Falloff). Kills count for the owner. On Hit runs later for this projectile only, with what it hit (each bounce too); On Expired when its time runs out. 64 fly at most; a new round clears them.
nodes.keywords: projectile rocket arrow fireball bullet throw shoot missile grenade

nodes.title: Projectile Hit
nodes.help: Runs when a projectile hits something: where, the surface's normal there, what it hit (World: a wall or the floor), and a player's hitgroup (1 head, 2 chest, 3 stomach, 4-5 arms, 6-7 legs; 0 unknown).

nodes.title: Remove Projectile
nodes.help: Takes a projectile away at once (no hit, no damage).

nodes.title: Projectile Velocity
nodes.help: How fast and which way a projectile flies (units a second).

nodes.title: Set Projectile Velocity
nodes.help: Sends a projectile off at a new velocity (its facing follows).

nodes.title: Give Healing Item
nodes.help: Gives a player bandages (+15 up to 75), medkits (full health) or drinks (+40 over 10 s), up to the carry limit.

nodes.title: Healing Items
nodes.help: How many healing items a player carries.

nodes.title: Set Armor Levels
nodes.help: Sets a player's vest and helmet levels (1-3; 0 none; keep: as they are).

nodes.title: Make Crate
nodes.help: Makes a crate at an entity with these items (loot items: ak47@30@60 bandage:2 vest2).

nodes.title: Rarity Glow
nodes.help: Makes an entity glow in a rarity's color (0 none, 1 white, 2 green, 3 blue, 4 purple, 5 gold).

nodes.title: Match HUD
nodes.help: Turns the match HUD on or off (players left, kills, the zone's timer, armor, healing items, the kill feed and the squad).

nodes.title: Match HUD Words
nodes.help: The mode's words in the match HUD in place of the zone's timer (empty: the zone again).

nodes.title: Kill Feed Line
nodes.help: Adds a line to the match HUD's kill feed.

nodes.title: Match Kills
nodes.help: A player's kills this round (counted while the match HUD is on).

nodes.title: Drop In
nodes.help: Drops a player in from high over a spot (an entity wired into At, else a spread-out landing spot: the map's br_drop markers); they fall slowly and take no damage until they land.

nodes.title: Landed
nodes.help: A player who dropped in is down on the ground.

nodes.title: Squad Lobby
nodes.help: A lobby of some seconds where people team up (say /squad); then the squads are filled (Lobby Ended). 0: fill them now.

nodes.title: Squad Size
nodes.help: Sets the squad size: 1 solo, 2 duos, 4 squads...

nodes.title: Lobby Ended
nodes.help: The squad lobby is over and the squads are filled.

nodes.title: Sides Alive
nodes.help: How many sides have someone alive (squads, and players in none).

nodes.title: Round Table On
nodes.help: Each Start Wave from now on plans a zombie-survival round on the map's wave spawners: how many (by round and team size), which creature types (unlocked by round, with stand-ins), their health, bosses, packs, heavies, tiers, how many alive at once. A waves.ini section replaces the built-in mix.

params.label: Creatures (no: dead players come back as the enemies)

nodes.title: Round Table Off
nodes.help: Waves go back to the spawners' own settings.

nodes.title: Round Difficulty
nodes.help: Times the round table's counts and health (the mode's difficulty).

nodes.title: Alive Cap
nodes.help: How many creatures at once (0: 16 + 2 a defender, 20-48; never over the game's own cap).

nodes.title: Creature Tiers
nodes.help: Tiers on (yellow from round 15, red-orange from 20) or off.

nodes.title: This Round
nodes.help: This round's plan: how many, how many made so far, the health times, whether it's a boss or a pack round (and the type).

nodes.title: Kill Pay
nodes.help: What the round table pays for killing this creature type.

nodes.title: Creatures Working
nodes.help: False once creatures can't spawn on this server (the table fell back to dead players).

nodes.title: Turrets
nodes.help: Turrets: friendly creatures that shoot the horde. A kit (Give Turret Kit, or a shop line with give=turret) is placed with USE where the player looks; bots are offered turret spots at this price. Price 0: off.

nodes.title: Give Turret Kit
nodes.help: Gives a player turret kits to place.

nodes.title: Place Turret
nodes.help: Places a turret where the player looks: from a kit, or paid at the turrets' price.

params.label: Pay for it (no: use a kit)

nodes.title: Turret Kits
nodes.help: How many turret kits a player has.

nodes.title: Turrets Out
nodes.help: How many turrets a player has out.

nodes.title: Turret Placed
nodes.help: A turret was placed.

nodes.title: Current Map Name
nodes.help: The map being played (de_dust2).

nodes.title: Next Map
nodes.help: The map the server goes to next (from the map cycle or vote); empty if it doesn't know.

nodes.title: Server Name
nodes.help: The server's name (hostname).

nodes.title: Max Players
nodes.help: How many players the server takes.

nodes.title: Player Count
nodes.help: How many players there are: everyone, people, bots, a team, or spectators.

nodes.title: Game Time
nodes.help: Seconds since the map started (for timing things: keep it in a variable, compare later).

nodes.title: Real Date and Time
nodes.help: The server computer's date and time, as text (2026-11-13, 21:30, Friday) and as seconds since 1970.

nodes.title: Current Mode
nodes.help: This mode's id (as the Game Mode Menu and modes.ini know it).

nodes.title: Round Number
nodes.help: Which round this is on this map (1 for the first).

nodes.title: Team Score
nodes.help: A team's rounds won on this map (as the scoreboard shows).

nodes.title: Is Freeze Time
nodes.help: Is it the freeze time at a round's start (nobody can move)?

nodes.title: Get Setting
nodes.help: Reads a server setting (a cvar), as a number and as text: the counterpart of Set Setting. Passwords and the like can't be read.

nodes.title: Change Map
nodes.help: Changes the map (if the server has it). The mode changes too only if the next map's preset says so. Asks first when an agent does it.

nodes.title: Restart Round
nodes.help: Restarts the round now (scores stay).

nodes.title: Has Helmet
nodes.help: Does the player have a helmet?

nodes.title: Weapon Held
nodes.help: The gun in the player's hands (ak47, knife...).

nodes.title: Ammo Of
nodes.help: Bullets in the held gun's magazine, and spare ones.

nodes.title: Has Weapon
nodes.help: Does the player carry this weapon?

nodes.title: Is Admin
nodes.help: Is the player an admin (the app's admins: AMX Mod X kick rights)?

nodes.title: Is VIP
nodes.help: Is the player a VIP (a reserved slot)?

nodes.title: Ping
nodes.help: The player's ping in milliseconds.

nodes.title: Steam ID
nodes.help: The player's Steam ID (STEAM_0:1:2345): the same each visit, for keeping things per player. Bots and LAN players have none (empty).

nodes.title: Is Spectator
nodes.help: Is the player watching (not on a team)?

nodes.title: Time Connected
nodes.help: Seconds since the player joined.

nodes.title: Player By Steam ID
nodes.help: The connected player with this Steam ID (STEAM_0:1:2345, as Steam ID gives it), or none; Found says which. Case and the STEAM_0 / STEAM_1 digit don't matter (the same player either way). Bots and LAN players have no Steam ID.

nodes.title: Is Supporter
nodes.help: Has the player the Loner-Strike supporter role (from the Loner-Strike Discord, kept in sync by the app: access flag s)? Not the same as Is VIP (a reserved slot on this server). Bots: no.

nodes.title: Player By Name
nodes.help: The player whose name has this text (none: no player).

nodes.title: Player By Index
nodes.help: The player in this slot (1 to Max Players; none if empty).

nodes.title: Gravity Of
nodes.help: A player's own gravity (1 normal; Set Gravity changes it).

nodes.title: Speed Of
nodes.help: A player's top speed now (Set Speed changes it).

nodes.title: Model Of
nodes.help: A player's model (Set Model changes it).

nodes.title: Get Transform
nodes.help: Where a player is, where they look (pitch, yaw), how fast they move, and whether they're on the ground or ducking.
nodes.keywords: location rotation velocity position transform angles

nodes.title: Set Transform
nodes.help: Moves a player, turns their view (pitch, yaw) and sets their velocity at once (unwired parts stay).

nodes.title: Set Rotation
nodes.help: Turns a player's view (pitch, yaw).

nodes.title: Look At
nodes.help: Turns a player's view toward an entity or a position.

nodes.title: Slap
nodes.help: Slaps a player: some damage and a push.

nodes.title: Screen Fade
nodes.help: Fills the player's screen with a color for some seconds (white: blinded).

nodes.title: Screen Shake
nodes.help: Shakes the player's screen.

nodes.title: God Mode
nodes.help: Nothing hurts the player (or back to normal).

nodes.title: No Clip
nodes.help: The player flies through walls (or back to normal).

nodes.title: Set Visibility
nodes.help: How a player is drawn: normal, see-through (an amount), or invisible.

nodes.title: Set Ammo
nodes.help: Sets the held gun's magazine and spare bullets.

nodes.title: Give Ammo
nodes.help: Adds spare bullets for the held gun (a minus takes them).

nodes.title: Remove Weapon
nodes.help: Takes one weapon from a player (the others stay).

nodes.title: Switch To Weapon
nodes.help: Makes the player take out this weapon (if they have it).

nodes.title: Set Kills
nodes.help: Sets a player's kills on the scoreboard.

nodes.title: Set Deaths
nodes.help: Sets a player's deaths on the scoreboard.

nodes.title: Move To Spectators
nodes.help: Moves a player out of the game to watch.

nodes.title: Kick
nodes.help: Kicks a player from the server with a reason. Asks first when an agent does it; community modes that use it show "kicks players". (Bans stay with the app's admins: use Notify Admins.)

nodes.title: Mute Voice
nodes.help: The player's voice isn't heard for some seconds (0: until the map ends).

nodes.title: Gag Chat
nodes.help: The player's chat isn't shown for some seconds (0: until the map ends).

nodes.title: Chat To Team
nodes.help: A chat line only one team sees.

nodes.title: Notify Admins
nodes.help: A chat line only admins see (for things a mode can't do itself, like a ban).

nodes.title: Entity Class Of
nodes.help: An entity's class (func_door, ls_creature...).

nodes.title: Entity Name Of
nodes.help: An entity's name (targetname) as the map gives it.

nodes.title: Find Entities
nodes.help: Every entity of a class or with a name, as an array (at most 512). Looks through the whole map: keep it in a variable instead of in a loop.

nodes.title: Spawn Prop
nodes.help: A model (models/...mdl, loaded with the map) at an entity's place; solid or not.

nodes.title: Remove Entity
nodes.help: Removes an entity (never a player).

nodes.title: Set Entity Position
nodes.help: Moves an entity.

nodes.title: Set Entity Rotation
nodes.help: Turns an entity (pitch, yaw, roll).

nodes.title: Set Entity Visibility
nodes.help: Shows or hides an entity.

nodes.title: Explosion
nodes.help: An explosion at a position: the look and sound, and damage to players within the radius (0: none).

nodes.title: Beam
nodes.help: A beam of light from one position to another for some seconds.

nodes.title: Play Sound At
nodes.help: A sound (sound/...wav, loaded with the map) heard around a position.

nodes.title: Play Sound To Player
nodes.help: A sound only one player hears (from the game's own sounds).

nodes.title: Set Light Style
nodes.help: How bright the whole map is: normal, dark, darkest, bright, or flickering.

nodes.title: Status Icon
nodes.help: Shows, flashes or hides one of the game's own HUD status icons (the buy zone cart, C4, the defuser, the rescue zone...) for a player or everyone (no Player), in a color. Only the icons every player's game has (its hud.txt): for your own pictures use Objective Marker or Show HUD Text. Until death: it goes when they die or leave.
nodes.keywords: hud icon status buyzone c4 defuser objective

nodes.title: Objective Marker
nodes.help: A sprite that floats over an entity (wired into Follow: a player, an NPC, an interactable, a component; it follows it) or at a position, for everyone, one team or one player. The sprite is one of the game's (sprites/arrow1.spr) or your own (sprites/...spr: it goes with the mode, like its other files). Remove it with Remove Marker; it goes by itself when what it follows is gone.
nodes.keywords: waypoint objective arrow icon sprite marker quest

nodes.title: Remove Marker
nodes.help: Takes away an Objective Marker (the one wired in, or all of them with none).

nodes.title: Kill Feed Line
nodes.help: A line in the top-right kill feed for everyone: Killer (or none: the world), the weapon's icon, Victim, and the headshot mark. Only the feed: nobody dies, nothing is counted (Player Killed doesn't run).

nodes.title: Set On Fire
nodes.help: Sets a living player on fire for some seconds: damage each second (Lit by gets the kill), flames on them. Water or the time running out puts it out; so does Put Out Fire, death or a new round.

nodes.title: Put Out Fire
nodes.help: Puts out a player Set On Fire.

nodes.title: Trail
nodes.help: A colored trail behind a player or an entity as it moves (on), or none (off). It comes back after a respawn and when they start moving again.

nodes.title: Effect Burst
nodes.help: A burst at a position or an entity: sparks, smoke, blood, a firework, an implosion, a tar explosion, a teleport flash, a lava splash or a colored flash. Count repeats it (up to 10); Color is for the firework and the flash.
nodes.keywords: effect particles sparks smoke blood firework explosion

nodes.title: Swap Places
nodes.help: Two living players trade places, the way they face and their speed. Not when either would end up stuck in a wall (Swapped is No then).

nodes.title: Bury
nodes.help: Sinks a living player into the floor up to the chest; they can't walk, but can look round and shoot. Unbury gets them out (also death and a new round).

nodes.title: Unbury
nodes.help: Gets a buried player out of the floor, onto it (never into a wall).

nodes.title: Set Camera
nodes.help: A player's view: third person (from behind), back to first person, or the other of the two. Back to first person on death/respawn: on, death ends it; off, they stay in third person through deaths and respawns. Leaving always ends it.

params.label: Back to first person on death/respawn

nodes.title: Is Third Person
nodes.help: Is the player's view third person (Set Camera)?

nodes.title: View From
nodes.help: A cinematic view: the chosen players (the wired one, a team or everyone) see from a position and angles, or from an entity (following it, Offset above it), for some seconds (0: until Return View). Move to: it glides there over Move time. Death, leaving and a new round give the view back by themselves. Freeze: they can't move or shoot meanwhile. A map's own trigger_camera still works.
nodes.keywords: camera cinematic cutscene view intro shot

nodes.title: Return View
nodes.help: Gives back the normal view (first or third person, as Set Camera left it) after View From: to the wired player, or everyone viewing.

nodes.title: Drunk View
nodes.help: Wobbles a player's view for some seconds, gently (1) to wildly (10); it stops cleanly (also on death).

nodes.title: As Player
nodes.help: Casting: is this entity a player (a slot 1-32 that's connected, bots too)? Success with it as a Player, else Failed. Use it where an Entity wire should go into a Player pin.
nodes.keywords: casting cast as player entity convert

nodes.title: As Creature
nodes.help: Casting: is this entity one of the bot brain's creatures? Success with it as a Creature (and its type), else Failed.
nodes.keywords: casting cast as creature entity convert

nodes.title: Is NPC
nodes.help: Casting: is the entity an NPC (ls_npc)?

nodes.title: Is Interactable
nodes.help: Casting: is the entity an interactable (ls_interactable, a point or a brush)?

nodes.title: Kind Of
nodes.help: Casting: what the entity is, as the built-in Entity Kind enum: Player, Bot, Creature, NPC, Interactable, Component, Prop (Spawn Prop's), Map entity or None. Wire it into Switch on Enum: one output per kind, nothing to type.

nodes.title: Component Kind Of
nodes.help: Casting: which kind of game mode component the entity is, as the built-in Component Kind enum (capture point, shop, barricade, timed door...), or None. Wire it into Switch on Enum for one output per kind.

nodes.title: Is Component
nodes.help: Casting: is the entity a game mode component (any, or of one kind: a capture point, a shop, a barricade...)?

nodes.title: Call Plugin Function
nodes.help: Calls a public function in another AMX Mod X plugin (by its file, like gm_components.amxx) with up to two numbers; Result is what it returns. Community modes that use it show "calls other plugins".

nodes.title: Plugin Is Running
nodes.help: Is this AMX Mod X plugin loaded and running?

nodes.title: Fire Custom Event
nodes.help: Sends an event with a name and two numbers that other plugins (and other Studio modes, with On Custom Event) can listen to (forward ls_studio_event(name[], a, b)).

nodes.title: On Custom Event
nodes.help: Runs when this mode or another plugin fires a custom event with this name.

nodes.title: Player Said
nodes.help: Runs when a player chats (anything; Team Only for team chat).

nodes.title: Freeze Time Ended
nodes.help: Runs when the freeze time ends and players can move.

nodes.title: Map Ending
nodes.help: Runs when the map ends (the scoreboard shows), just before the next map.

nodes.title: Weapon Fired
nodes.help: Runs when a player shoots (at most 10 times a second per player). Frequent: keep the flow short.

nodes.title: Reloaded
nodes.help: Runs when a player starts reloading.

nodes.title: Hostage Rescued
nodes.help: Runs when a player rescues a hostage.

nodes.title: VIP Escaped
nodes.help: Runs when the VIP escapes.

nodes.title: Bots: Phase
nodes.help: Tells the bots what part of the game it is: Loot (nobody is an enemy: they gear up and keep apart), Fight, or back to normal. Personality influence: 0 they obey exactly; 50 as usual; 100 each bot's personality and skill decide (a careful one may turn a risky job down, a slow one starts later).

nodes.title: Bots: Don't Buy
nodes.help: Bots skip buying (they leave the buy time at once and get on with the mode), or buy again.

nodes.title: Bots: Friends
nodes.help: Makes two groups friends for the bots (they won't attack each other and may stick together), or not. A tag is set with Bots: Tag.

nodes.title: Bots: Tag
nodes.help: Gives a player a tag (a squad, a job) so other Bots nodes can name them all at once.

nodes.title: Bots: Prefer Layer
nodes.help: Bots look for loot and hold on this layer of the map: below (tunnels, basements), the surface, or high (roofs, ridges); or their own choice again. Personality influence: 0 they obey exactly; 50 as usual; 100 each bot's personality and skill decide (a careful one may turn a risky job down, a slow one starts later).

nodes.title: Bots: Fight Creatures
nodes.help: Bots treat the mode's creatures as enemies (on by default where creatures attack), or not.

nodes.title: Bots: Goal
nodes.help: Gives bots something to do at an entity: defend or capture it, use it (hold USE), loot it, or go and hold there, with a priority (0-100), for some seconds, within a radius. Personality influence: 0 they obey exactly; 50 as usual; 100 each bot's personality and skill decide (a careful one may turn a risky job down, a slow one starts later).

params.label: Goal
choices: Hunt it (a player or creature, wherever it goes)

nodes.title: Bots: Clear Goals
nodes.help: Takes back goals given with Bots: Goal (all of them, or one kind).

nodes.title: Bots: Offer
nodes.help: Tells bots something here can be bought or used for a price (a perk, an upgrade bench, a mystery box, a trap, a turret spot); they take it like a person would, when they can afford it and it's calm. Personality influence: 0 they obey exactly; 50 as usual; 100 each bot's personality and skill decide (a careful one may turn a risky job down, a slow one starts later).

params.label: What
choices: An interactable (they press E on it)
A pickup (they walk over it; Price is its weight 0-100, Order 0 an item, 1 a weapon, 2 health)

nodes.title: Bots: Clear Offer
nodes.help: Takes back an offer (it's bought or used up), or all of them.

nodes.title: Bot Go To
nodes.help: Sends a bot to the entity with this name (it still fights on the way), for some seconds (0: until freed).

nodes.title: Bot Hold
nodes.help: Makes a bot hold where it is for some seconds.

nodes.title: Bot Follow
nodes.help: Makes a bot follow a player for some seconds. Personality influence: 0 they obey exactly; 50 as usual; 100 each bot's personality and skill decide (a careful one may turn a risky job down, a slow one starts later).

nodes.title: Bot Nature
nodes.help: A bot's nature, as the bot brain plays it: Skill, Aggression, Teamwork and Greed (0-100) and its playstyle (rusher, lurker, careful, camper...). People read 0 and empty.

nodes.title: Bot Trait
nodes.help: Is the bot bold, cautious, a team player, a loner, greedy, skilled or a novice (as the bot brain sees it)? False for people.

nodes.title: Bot Free
nodes.help: Lets a bot do as it likes again.

nodes.title: Load Map Pack
nodes.help: Loads another mode's map pack for this map (configs/gamemodes/components/<map>.<pack>.ini): br, laststand...

nodes.title: Start Component
nodes.help: Starts a component that waits to be started (a zone shrinker with start_delay -1).

nodes.title: Stop Component
nodes.help: Stops a component.

nodes.title: Barricade Health
nodes.help: A barricade's health now.

nodes.title: Zone Stage
nodes.help: The Shrinking zone's stage (the zone or its shrinker); 0 before the first.

nodes.title: Zone Next
nodes.help: When the zone next moves: seconds until it starts (or, while it's closing, until it stops), its next radius, whether it's closing now. Seconds is -1 when nothing is planned.

nodes.title: Is In Zone
nodes.help: Is the player inside the zone?

nodes.title: Respawn At Point
nodes.help: Brings a dead player back at a respawn point (ls_respawn_point), or moves a living one there.

nodes.title: Call Supply Drop
nodes.help: Calls a supply drop onto an entity (wired into At, or the one with this name).

nodes.title: Creatures Alive
nodes.help: How many creatures are alive.

nodes.title: Player About To Be Hurt
nodes.help: Runs just before a player takes damage. Block, scale or set the damage here (it happens straight after this flow).

nodes.title: Block Damage
nodes.help: The damage doesn't happen. Only in a Player About To Be Hurt flow.

nodes.title: Scale Damage
nodes.help: Multiplies the damage (0.5 halves it). Only in a Player About To Be Hurt flow.

nodes.title: Set Damage
nodes.help: Sets the damage to this. Only in a Player About To Be Hurt flow.

nodes.title: No Fall Damage
nodes.help: Stops a player taking fall damage: always, or just for their next landing (a drop-in).

nodes.title: Make Downed
nodes.help: A player who just died lies downed where they fell: a teammate (or squad mate) holding USE on them for a few seconds brings them back; if nobody does in time they're out. Bots come to help.

nodes.title: Revive Pay
nodes.help: Money for getting a teammate up (the components' downed players: Last Stand, Battle Royale), once a downing, never for getting yourself up; bots get it too. 0: off.

nodes.title: Is Downed
nodes.help: Is the player downed (waiting for a revive)?

nodes.title: Player Revived
nodes.help: Runs when a downed player is brought back.

nodes.title: Downed Player Out
nodes.help: Runs when nobody revived a downed player in time.

nodes.title: Set Squad
nodes.help: Puts a player in a squad (1 to 32; 0 none). Squad mates are on one side for the bots, and can't hurt each other unless squad friendly fire is on.

nodes.title: Squad Of
nodes.help: The squad a player is in (0 none).

nodes.title: Squads Left
nodes.help: How many squads still have someone alive (a living player in no squad counts as one).

nodes.title: Squad Friendly Fire
nodes.help: Whether squad mates can hurt each other.

nodes.title: Buying
nodes.help: Where players can buy: anywhere, only in buy zones, or nowhere.

nodes.title: Allow Buying
nodes.help: Lets players buy only some things (or everything again).

params.label: What
choices: Nothing at all (the spawn pistol stays)

nodes.title: Saved Value
nodes.help: A number kept for this player across maps, restarts and crashes (0 until set). Each mode has its own file.

nodes.title: Save Value
nodes.help: Keeps a number for this player across maps and restarts.

nodes.title: Add To Saved
nodes.help: Adds to a saved number (a minus takes away).

nodes.title: Set Round Clock
nodes.help: Runs the mode's own round clock: this many seconds, shown on everyone's round timer. When it reaches 0, Round Time Up runs (the game's own time limit is switched off while it runs).

nodes.title: Add Round Time
nodes.help: Adds seconds to the mode's round clock (a minus takes away).

nodes.title: Pause Round Clock
nodes.help: Stops or restarts the mode's round clock.

nodes.title: Round Time Left
nodes.help: Seconds left on the mode's round clock (0 when it isn't running).

nodes.title: Launch Up
nodes.help: Throws a living player straight up (with low gravity and No Fall Damage, a drop-in from the sky).

nodes.title: Round Time Up
nodes.help: Runs when the mode's round clock reaches 0.

nodes.title: Function Entry
nodes.help: Where a Function starts. Its outputs are the Function's inputs (add them in Details).

nodes.title: Return Node
nodes.help: Ends the Function and hands back its outputs (add them in Details).

nodes.title: Call
nodes.help: Runs a Function (with its own graph), then carries on with its outputs.

nodes.title: Call Pure
nodes.help: Works out a pure Function's outputs where they're used (no flow pins).

nodes.title: Macro Entry
nodes.help: Where a Macro starts: its inputs (flow and values).

nodes.title: Macro Exit
nodes.help: Where a Macro ends: its outputs (flow and values).

nodes.title: Macro
nodes.help: A Macro's graph, copied in here when the mode is made.

nodes.title: Sequence
nodes.help: Runs each output in turn, top to bottom.

nodes.title: Do Once
nodes.help: Lets the flow through the first time only, until Reset.

nodes.title: Do N
nodes.help: Lets the flow through N times, until Reset.

nodes.title: Gate
nodes.help: Flow coming into Enter goes through only while the gate is open.

nodes.title: Flip Flop
nodes.help: Goes to A, then B, then A again... Is A says which it just did.

nodes.title: For Loop
nodes.help: Runs Loop Body once for each number from First to Last (at most 10000 times), then Completed.

nodes.title: For Loop with Break
nodes.help: A For Loop that stops early when flow comes into Break.

nodes.title: While Loop
nodes.help: Runs Loop Body while the condition is true (checked each time; at most Limit times), then Completed.

nodes.title: For Each
nodes.help: Runs Loop Body once for each item of an array (Break stops early), then Completed.

nodes.title: Switch on Number
nodes.help: Goes to the output whose case is the number (cases split by commas), or Default.

nodes.title: Switch on Text
nodes.help: Goes to the output whose case is the text (capitals don't matter; cases split by commas), or Default.

nodes.title: Switch on Enum
nodes.help: Goes to the output for the enum's value.

nodes.title: Is Valid?
nodes.help: Goes to Is Valid when the entity (or player) is there, else Is Not Valid.

nodes.title: Retriggerable Delay
nodes.help: Waits, then carries on; flow coming in again while waiting starts the wait again.

nodes.title: Set Timer by Function
nodes.help: Runs a Function (with its own graph) after some seconds, again and again if Looping. Its inputs get nothing (0, empty).

nodes.title: Set Timer by Event
nodes.help: Runs a Custom Event (with no inputs) after some seconds, again and again if Looping.

nodes.title: Custom Event
nodes.help: Runs when something calls this Custom Event (Call Custom Event, Set Timer by Event, or the map: an ls_event entity, or an info_target named lsev_<its map name>, when triggered). Its inputs are its own (My mode, Custom events).

nodes.title: Call Custom Event
nodes.help: Runs a Custom Event now, with these values (every Custom Event node for it, in the graphs' order).

nodes.title: For Each Creature
nodes.help: Runs Each once for every creature alive (of a type, or any), then Then. Friendly ones (turrets) are left out. Every creature each time it runs: keep it out of per-frame flows.

nodes.title: Creatures of Type
nodes.help: Every creature alive of a type (empty: any), as an array. Looks through them all each time: keep it in a variable instead of in a loop.

nodes.title: Nearest Creature
nodes.help: The creature alive nearest to a point or an entity (a player, a gate), of a type or any; nobody if there are none.

nodes.title: Creature Type
nodes.help: A creature's type (zombie, runner...); empty for anything else.

nodes.title: Idle For
nodes.help: Seconds a creature has stood still (moved less than 32 units). Counted once a second.

nodes.title: Can See
nodes.help: Is there a clear line from the creature's eyes to a player or entity?

nodes.title: Creature Go To
nodes.help: Sends a creature to a place: an entity wired in (a player, a marker's entity), a point, or the entity with this name. Guard there: it stays and fights there. Then resume: it goes back to hunting once there.

nodes.title: Creature Attack
nodes.help: Makes a creature go after a player or an entity (a gate, a turret) until it's gone.

nodes.title: Creature Hold
nodes.help: Makes a creature stay where it is (it guards the spot: it still fights what comes close, then comes back) until Resume AI or Go To.

nodes.title: Creature Resume AI
nodes.help: Gives a creature back to its own AI: what its type does by itself (wander, patrol, guard or hunt), its spawn spot as home, no target forced. With an older bot brain it hunts instead.

nodes.title: Creature State
nodes.help: What a creature is doing now: 1 idle, 2 wander, 3 patrol, 4 guard, 5 chase, 6 flee, 7 attack, 8 search, 9 dead (0: not a creature). Name gives the word (idle ... dead). Needs a bot brain with creature control 2 (ls_creature_ver 2); the mode says so in the server log when it's older.
nodes.keywords: mode doing ai behavior chasing fleeing

nodes.title: Creature Target
nodes.help: Who a creature is after now: a player or another creature; nobody when none. Needs a bot brain with creature control 2 (ls_creature_ver 2); the mode says so in the server log when it's older.

nodes.title: Set Creature Speed
nodes.help: Times a creature's normal walk and run speed (0.2 to 3; 1 is its own) until it dies. Enraged comes on top. Needs a bot brain with creature control 2 (ls_creature_ver 2); the mode says so in the server log when it's older.

nodes.title: Set Creature Tier
nodes.help: Makes a creature tier 0 to 3 (2: a yellow shell, 3: red-orange and a bit bigger), as the spawn key tier does; its health keeps its share. Needs a bot brain with creature control 2 (ls_creature_ver 2); the mode says so in the server log when it's older.

nodes.title: Creature Flee To
nodes.help: Makes a creature run away to a place (an entity wired in, a point, or the entity with this name).

nodes.title: Set Creature Health
nodes.help: Sets a creature's health (and its full health, so it isn't over).

nodes.title: Remove Creature
nodes.help: Takes a creature away. Kill: it dies (Creature Killed runs, waves count it; nobody is paid). Remove quietly: it's gone, nothing runs.

nodes.title: Creature Idle
nodes.help: Runs when a creature has stood still this many seconds (and, if asked, can't see any player): send it somewhere with Creature Go To. Runs again after as many seconds if it's still stuck.

params.label: Only when no player is in sight

nodes.title: Get Row
nodes.help: Finds the row whose key is this (the table's key column) and gives each of its cells. Found is No when no row has that key (the cells are then 0, No or empty).
nodes.keywords: lookup data table row key csv

nodes.title: Get Cell
nodes.help: One cell: a column of a row (rows count from 0). Past the end: 0, No or empty.

nodes.title: For Each Row
nodes.help: Runs Each once for every row of the table, in order, with that row's cells; then Then.

nodes.title: Find Rows
nodes.help: The rows (as row numbers) where a column has this value, in order. Use Get Cell on each.

nodes.title: Row Count
nodes.help: How many rows the table has.

nodes.title: Row Keys
nodes.help: The table's keys (its key column), in row order.

nodes.title: Timeline
nodes.help: Plays a Timeline (My mode, Timelines): values that change over time (a number, a position, a color) and events at set moments. Update runs every tick while it plays; Finished at the end. In a Function with a Player input, each player has their own. Double-click to edit its tracks.
nodes.keywords: animation curve keyframe tween interpolate move platform

nodes.title: Clear Timer
nodes.help: Stops a timer (a Delay, Repeat, Countdown or Set Timer's handle).

nodes.title: Is Timer Active
nodes.help: Is the timer waiting to run?

nodes.title: Print String
nodes.help: Prints text (and a value wired in) to the server console and the Studio's output, and to chat if you like.

nodes.title: Equal
nodes.help: Are the two values the same (or different)?

nodes.title: Select
nodes.help: Picks A when the condition is true, else B.

nodes.title: Is Valid
nodes.help: Is the entity (or player) there?

nodes.title: Is Player
nodes.help: Is the entity a player (or bot) in the game?

nodes.title: Is Creature
nodes.help: Is the entity one of the bot brain's creatures?

nodes.title: Math Function
nodes.help: Absolute value, rounding, square root and more; Truncate drops the fraction toward zero (-2.7 becomes -2, where Round down gives -3).
nodes.keywords: sign abs absolute round floor ceil sqrt truncate trunc

nodes.title: Clamp

nodes.help: Is there a clear line between A and B (each an entity or a point)? Entities wired in don't block it (a player's eyes are used). Hit Position is where something got in the way.
nodes.keywords: visible see trace los sight blocked wall

nodes.title: Random Chance
nodes.help: Yes Percent % of the time (a new roll each time it's worked out).
nodes.keywords: probability odds percent roll luck dice

nodes.title: Random Bool
nodes.help: Yes or no, half the time each.

nodes.title: Weighted Random Pick
nodes.help: Picks an index from an array of weights (a weight of 3 is picked three times as often as 1); with Items wired, the item at that index too. -1 when every weight is 0.
nodes.keywords: loot table chance roll pick weight drop

nodes.title: Map Range
nodes.help: A value from one range moved into another: In Min..In Max becomes Out Min..Out Max (Clamp keeps it inside).

nodes.title: Sin / Cos / Tan
nodes.help: The sine, cosine or tangent of an angle (degrees, or radians).
nodes.keywords: sine cosine tangent trigonometry angle wave

nodes.title: Atan2
nodes.help: The angle of the direction X, Y (from the X axis, -180..180 degrees, or radians).

nodes.title: Degrees / Radians
nodes.help: Degrees to radians or radians to degrees.

nodes.title: Nearly Equal
nodes.help: Are A and B within Tolerance of each other (for numbers that came out of math, which are seldom exactly equal)?
nodes.keywords: approximately close equal epsilon float compare

nodes.title: Split Text
nodes.help: Text cut at each Separator, as an array of texts (at most 64 pieces; empty pieces kept).

nodes.title: Replace Text
nodes.help: The text with every Find replaced by With (capitals matter).

nodes.title: Substring
nodes.help: Part of the text: Length characters from Start (the first is 0).
nodes.keywords: part mid slice cut left right characters

nodes.title: Upper Case
nodes.help: THE TEXT IN CAPITALS.

nodes.title: Lower Case
nodes.help: the text in small letters.

nodes.title: Trim Text
nodes.help: The text without spaces at the start and end.

nodes.title: Starts With
nodes.help: Does the text start with this (capitals don't matter)?

nodes.title: Ends With
nodes.help: Does the text end with this (capitals don't matter)?

nodes.title: Join Array
nodes.help: An array's texts in one, with Separator between them (as much as fits in 127 characters).

nodes.title: Format Time
nodes.help: Seconds as a clock: 1:05, or 1:02:05 (Auto: hours only when there are any).

nodes.title: Format Number
nodes.help: A number as text with a set number of decimals, and thousands separated by commas if you like (12,345.6).

nodes.title: Sum
nodes.help: All the numbers added up (0 for an empty array).

nodes.title: Array Min
nodes.help: The smallest number, and its index (-1 for an empty array).

nodes.title: Array Max
nodes.help: The biggest number, and its index (-1 for an empty array).

nodes.title: Average
nodes.help: The numbers' average (0 for an empty array).

nodes.title: Reverse
nodes.help: Turns an array round: the last item first.

nodes.title: Slice
nodes.help: A new array with Count items from Start (the first is 0).

nodes.title: Dot Product
nodes.help: A·B: how much two directions point the same way (with both length 1: 1 same, 0 square, -1 opposite).

nodes.title: Cross Product
nodes.help: A×B: the direction square to both (its length is how far apart they point).

nodes.title: Random Point In Radius
nodes.help: A random point within Radius of Center: on a flat circle (2D, Z kept) or in a ball (3D).

nodes.title: Rotate Vector
nodes.help: Turns a vector round the vertical by Yaw degrees (and up or down by Pitch).

nodes.title: Lerp Vector
nodes.help: A point between A and B: Alpha 0 is A, 1 is B, 0.5 halfway.

nodes.title: Direction To Angles
nodes.help: A direction as angles (pitch, yaw, 0), for aiming and Look At math.
nodes.keywords: aim pitch yaw look rotation vector to angles

nodes.title: Angles To Forward Vector
nodes.help: Angles (pitch, yaw, roll) as the direction they face, length 1.
nodes.keywords: forward direction facing aim angle vector

nodes.title: To Local Space
nodes.help: A world position as seen from a player or entity: X forward, Y right, Z up (by its facing; a player's view yaw).
nodes.keywords: relative local offset forward right up

nodes.title: To World Space
nodes.help: An offset from a player or entity (X forward, Y right, Z up, by its facing) as a world position.
nodes.keywords: relative offset in front behind spawn position

nodes.title: Relative Position Of
nodes.help: How far B is in front of, to the right of and above A (by A's facing; behind and left are negative).

nodes.title: Angle To
nodes.help: How far A would turn to face B: the yaw difference, -180..180 degrees (positive: to the left).

nodes.title: Is In Front
nodes.help: Is B in front of A, inside a cone of this many degrees round A's facing?

nodes.title: Is Behind
nodes.help: Is B behind A, inside a cone of this many degrees round A's back (backstabs, sneaking)?

nodes.title: Eye Position
nodes.help: Where a player's eyes are (their position plus view height).

nodes.title: Aim Direction
nodes.help: Which way a player is aiming, length 1 (from their view angles).

nodes.title: Aim Point
nodes.help: What a player is aiming at, up to Max distance: where the line from their eyes hits, the entity hit, the surface's normal, and whether it hit anything (the player is ignored).
nodes.keywords: trace crosshair looking at target raycast

nodes.title: Multi Gate
nodes.help: Each time flow comes in, goes out the next output (in order, or random); after the last it stops, or starts over with Loop. Reset starts again from Start index.
nodes.keywords: round robin cycle rotate sequence each

nodes.title: Do Once Per Player
nodes.help: Lets the flow through once for each player, until Reset (everyone) or Reset Player (the player wired in then).

nodes.title: Toggle Variable
nodes.help: Flips a yes/no variable (yes becomes no, no becomes yes); New Value is what it is now. A per-player one needs a Player, a per-team one a Team.
nodes.keywords: flip switch invert not bool toggle

nodes.title: On Tick
nodes.help: Runs again and again, every Interval seconds (0.1: ten times a second; 0: every server frame), all through the map. Delta is the seconds since the last time.
nodes.keywords: update frame loop every tick think interval
